description: Sacramento, CA - Elk Grove City Councilwoman Stephanie Nguyen's Campaign for State Assembly announced today the endorsement of California Lieutenant Governor Eleni Kounalakis. "Stephanie is exactly the type of leader our State needs. As a mother, a councilwoman and as the Executive Director for a nonprofit that uplifts immigrant families, her passion for making a difference is commendable and unmistakable. Please join me in supporting Stephanie Nguyen for California State Assembly 10th District.

title: California Lieutenant Governor Eleni Kounalakis Endorses Stephanie Nguyen for Assembly
